name: carnet
description: A project notebook for work with AI agents: a bounded state file loaded at session start, deadlines read from it, a journal, a private error journal whose counts decide when a rule or a check is due, and guards. Installs with it: arbitrage (decisions), pilote (delegation to subagents and Codex) and prompts (prompt engineering with sources).

gardes.title: Guards mode
gardes.description: avertir: a guard adds a warning the agent sees and blocks nothing. bloquer: a guard refuses the action. The secrets guard always blocks.

fuseau.title: Time zone
fuseau.description: IANA name such as Europe/Paris, used when a project does not set one. Empty: the machine's zone.
